_comment: Questions the documents do not answer: plausible for this product, next to topics the documents cover. Written and frozen on 2026-11-17, before any answer, relevance-gate, or rewrite run. Each was checked by searching the five documents for its key terms (none found); topics the documents turned out to cover (mobile apps, CSV export, PayPal, restoring deleted tasks, interface languages, guests, currencies, version 7.0, security keys, recurring tasks, imports, the board view) were dropped. Dev questions choose the relevance-gate threshold; test questions report it.
